title: T-15 pre-registration: Brownian phase recovery of delta_f_hat
question: Can 50 Brownian-phase injections in two families yield an auditable recovery scatter for delta_f_hat with the current Kerr V2 postpeak 220 instrument and at most one T15 machine-hour?

design_if_all_gates_pass.injection: 220 postpeak plus Brownian phase realization with seed per injection, fixed onset, pinned readout and estimator; match each realization to a paired GR injection and identical off-source noise
design_if_all_gates_pass.seed_rule: record base seed and derived unique injection/noise seeds before running; no seed selection after inspecting fitted values
design_if_all_gates_pass.noise: GW250114 real off-source H1+L1; each detector must pass the registered covariance condition <= 1e12; no B3 regularized or B4 synthetic sample may be called real-network recovery
design_if_all_gates_pass.fit: Kerr V2 220 with explicit delta_f220, identical priors and fit window in paired Brownian/GR recoveries; free Mf/af requires an independently identified mode or an externally specified inspiral prior (then label IMR-RD)
design_if_all_gates_pass.estimand: within-family scatter of paired (delta_f_hat_Brownian - delta_f_hat_GR) over independent noise/phase realizations, with uncertainty interval; report posterior widths separately
design_if_all_gates_pass.qualification: both detector noise covariances pass; delta_f model exists; likelihood/sampler converges; null-direction removed by measured two-mode information or ratified external prior; pilot cost forecast <= 1.0 allocated machine-hour
design_if_all_gates_pass.pilot: only after all qualification checks, run exactly two injections (one per family), inspect convergence and actual time; 1.0 hour absolute allocation
design_if_all_gates_pass.failure_action: if any qualification fails, do not run the two-injection pilot or campaign; emit MEDIDA with numerical cost and required protocol change

known_before_execution.T10_Aprime: rank 3 only for a proposed 440 mode; injected 440 amplitude zero; no two-mode posterior
known_before_execution.T10_bank: 10 GR waveforms generated, no PE transfer
